title.zh: 首达

dek.en: PhD research: when a random walker first arrives
dek.zh: 博士研究：随机游走何时第一次到达

card.en: Why one target can have two arrival peaks, and exactly when the second dies: a single-author paper submitted to Physical Review E (a physics journal).
card.zh: 一个目标为何会有两个到达峰，第二个峰又何时消失——单作者论文，已投稿《物理评论 E》。

why.en: First-passage times are everywhere a search has to succeed: a molecule finding a receptor, a signal crossing a network, a pest finding a trap (Chapter 07).
why.zh: 凡是需要「找到」的地方都有首达时间：分子找到受体、信号穿过网络、害虫走进诱捕器（见第 7 章）。

title.zh: 几何控制的折叠：双峰论文

status.en: Submitted to Physical Review E · Jul 2026

card.en: Single-author regular article, the capstone of the double-peak line. Submitted to Physical Review E (a physics journal), 30 Jul 2026.
card.zh: 单作者常规论文，双峰研究线的收官之作。2026 年 7 月 30 日投稿《物理评论 E》。

title.en: Why a second peak is born — and dies
title.zh: 第二个峰为何出生，又为何消失

card.en: The shortcut removes walkers at one site (a ‘rank-one killing defect’); at strength ≈ 3.08 the late peak meets a valley and both vanish.
card.zh: 用数学语言说，捷径相当于在一个位置吸收游走者的缺陷（秩一吸收缺陷）；强度约 3.08 时，晚峰与谷相撞消失（鞍结折叠）。

title.zh: 布里斯托大学工程数学博士

title.zh: 跳过输入法？

dek.en: First AI paper · UKAIRS 2026, the UK AI Research Symposium
dek.zh: 第一篇 AI 论文 · 英国 AI 研究研讨会（UKAIRS 2026）

card.en: Can AI agents read raw pinyin (romanised Chinese)? The Edinburgh poster says: for routine prompts, yes; homophones need the key word in characters.
card.zh: 直接敲拼音，AI 智能体读得懂吗？带去爱丁堡的海报给出答案：日常指令可以，同音词要把关键词写成汉字。

why.en: Many languages are typed through an input method — software that turns typed letters into characters — or a romanisation: pinyin (romanised Chinese), Japanese romaji, Arabizi. Knowing where meaning survives the shortcut tells people when they can skip that step with an AI agent.
why.zh: 很多语言都要靠输入法或罗马化来打字——拼音、日语罗马字、阿拉伯语的拉丁转写。弄清楚意思在哪里会丢，才知道什么时候可以跟 AI 智能体省掉这一步。

thesis.en: Can AI agents read raw pinyin (romanised Chinese)? The Edinburgh poster says: for routine prompts, yes; homophones need the key word in characters.
thesis.zh: 直接敲拼音，AI 智能体读得懂吗？带去爱丁堡的海报给出答案：日常指令可以，同音词要把关键词写成汉字。

title.en: The key finding: toneless pinyin erases homophones
title.zh: 核心发现：无声调拼音抹掉同音字

card.en: 事实 and 实施 are both ‘shi shi’. Pinyin-only prompts scored 0.333; keeping the key word in Chinese characters restored 1.00.
card.zh: 「事实」与「实施」都是 shi shi。纯拼音提示只得 0.333；把关键词留成汉字，就回到 1.00。

title.en: Accepted at UKAIRS 2026: the first AI paper
title.zh: UKAIRS 2026 录用：第一篇 AI 论文

card.en: UKAIRS 2026 accepted the paper for a poster. The reviewers singled out the ‘shi shi’ example as the message to lead with.
card.zh: UKAIRS 2026 录用本文，以海报展示。评审特别点出「shi shi」这个例子，建议以它开场。

status.zh: 已排期 · 11 月 25 日海报

title.en: An AI-native way of doing mathematics
title.zh: 一种 AI 原生的做数学方式

card.en: Models propose, other agents attack, numerics arbitrate, and Lean, a proof assistant, checks the algebra. Belief is earned, not generated.
card.zh: 模型提出，另一组智能体攻击，数值来裁决，Lean（一种让计算机逐行检查数学证明的软件）核验代数。信念要靠挣，不靠生成。

title.zh: 引擎室

dek.en: R&D Scientist (AI) at Yuexin International, a cloud-communications company
dek.zh: 阅信国际 · AI 研发

card.en: Since June 2026 at Yuexin International: five AI systems built and live in four months — a gateway, a governed platform, a staff assistant.
card.zh: 2026 年 6 月起在阅信国际做 AI 研发：四个月里搭建并上线五套 AI 系统——网关、治理平台、员工助手等。

why.en: The aim: move the company from trying AI to using it every day — safely, with governance built in, and with a person confirming before anything is sent, shared or approved.
why.zh: 目标是让公司从「试试 AI」走到每天都在用 AI——安全、内置治理，任何内容发出、共享或审批之前，都先由人确认。

thesis.en: Since June 2026 at Yuexin International: five AI systems built and live in four months — a gateway, a governed platform, a staff assistant.
thesis.zh: 2026 年 6 月起在阅信国际做 AI 研发：四个月里搭建并上线五套 AI 系统——网关、治理平台、员工助手等。

title.zh: 阅信国际 · AI 研发

card.en: Three strands: the AI platform and model gateway, AI tools for colleagues, and AI for global messaging.
card.zh: 三条线：AI 平台与模型网关、给同事用的 AI 工具，以及面向国际短信业务的 AI 支持。

title.en: Yuexin AI Assistant — web and Windows
title.zh: 阅信 AI 助手——网页版与 Windows 版

card.en: Built and launched in a day: a staff assistant with single sign-on, personal quotas, self-serve keys and a Windows client.
card.zh: 一天内做出并上线的员工助手：飞书登录、个人额度、自助领取密钥，外加 Windows 客户端。

title.en: An enterprise platform for governed AI access
title.zh: 企业 AI 统一接入与治理平台

card.en: Organisations, teams, keys, model allow-lists, budgets, a data-loss hook and an audit hash-chain — built and live in one week.
card.zh: 组织、团队、密钥、模型白名单、预算、防泄漏回调与审计哈希链——一周之内搭好并上线。

title.zh: 展台

dek.en: Brand design, trade shows and talks

card.en: Giving a cloud-communications company an AI-era face: a logo system, materials for two trade shows (MWC Shanghai, WWC Madrid), a 93-minute AI primer.
card.zh: 为一家云通信公司打造 AI 时代的形象：一套标志、上海与马德里两场展会的物料、一堂 93 分钟的大模型入门课。

why.en: A company’s AI work is judged partly by how it presents itself — in English, on trade floors and in print — and by whether its own people can work with AI agents.
why.zh: 一家公司的 AI 做得怎样，一半要看它怎么展示自己——用英文、在展会上、在印刷品里；也要看它自己的员工，能不能和 AI 智能体一起工作。

thesis.en: Giving a cloud-communications company an AI-era face: a logo system, materials for two trade shows (MWC Shanghai, WWC Madrid), a 93-minute AI primer.
thesis.zh: 为一家云通信公司打造 AI 时代的形象：一套标志、上海与马德里两场展会的物料、一堂 93 分钟的大模型入门课。

title.en: ‘Trust Joint 2.0’: a logo, from sketches to final mark
title.zh: 「信榫 2.0」标志设计：从草图到定稿

card.en: Four AI sketches, checked for shape and for look-alikes, then redrawn by hand on a 1,000-unit grid: 20 master files, a 14-page guide.
card.zh: 四个 AI 草图方向，先查轮廓、再查是否撞脸已有标志，然后在 1000 单位网格上手工重绘：20 个母版文件，14 页规范。

title.en: ‘Intelligence. Delivered.’ — print and digital kit for a Madrid trade show
title.zh: 「智能，送达」——马德里展会的印刷与数字物料

card.en: Three rounds in four days: five one-pager types, three two-sided leaflets in two languages, four business cards — every QR code tested.
card.zh: 四天三轮：五种一页纸、中英文各三张双面宣传页、四张名片，二维码逐一解码验证。

title.en: ‘From SMS to Intelligent Channels’: a 93-minute primer on AI models
title.zh: 《从短信到智能通道》：93 分钟大模型入门课

card.en: A Chinese SMS is billed per 70 characters, a model per token: how the AI industry works, told through a business the team already knew.
card.zh: 一条中文短信按 70 个字计费，大模型按词元（token）计费：用团队最熟悉的生意，讲清大模型行业的来龙去脉。

title.en: MWC Shanghai 2026, a mobile-industry trade show
title.zh: 世界移动通信大会·上海（MWC 上海 2026）

card.en: Booth N4.E136, three days on the stand: 22 meeting dossiers and 49 personalised invitations before, 214 leads sorted after.
card.zh: N4.E136 展位，驻展三天：展前 22 份约见档案、49 条定制邀请，展后整理出 214 条去重线索。

title.en: WWC 2026 in Madrid, a telecoms trade show
title.zh: 国际电信批发大会（WWC 2026），马德里

card.en: Three days with the company’s four-person team: a live schedule of 22 meeting slots, and 31 exhibitor dossiers written during the show.
card.zh: 随公司四人团队参会三天：维护 22 个约见时段的实时排班，会期中写下 31 份参展商档案。

title.zh: 教学

dek.zh: 研究生助教与实验课助教

card.en: In front of students from the first month of the PhD; for 2026–27, 13 roles across three schools: tutorials, labs, problem classes, marking.
card.zh: 读博第一个月，就开始教课。2026 至 2027 学年：三个学院、13 个教学岗位，小班辅导、实验课、习题课与批改都有。

why.en: Teaching is where an explanation either works or it doesn’t: first-year tutorials, MSc labs, summer projects for business students.
why.zh: 一个讲法行不行，在课堂上当场见分晓：一年级小班课、硕士上机实验、商科学生的暑期项目。

thesis.en: In front of students from the first month of the PhD; for 2026–27, 13 roles across three schools: tutorials, labs, problem classes, marking.
thesis.zh: 读博第一个月，就开始教课。2026 至 2027 学年：三个学院、13 个教学岗位，小班辅导、实验课、习题课与批改都有。

title.zh: 7 月：新学年的教学分配

card.en: Eleven units at once — from first-year tutorials to an MSc group project — and in September a twelfth, Linear Algebra.
card.zh: 一次分到 11 门课——从一年级小班辅导到硕士小组项目；9 月又加了第 12 门：线性代数。

title.en: A Graduate Teacher from the first term
title.zh: 第一个学期就当上研究生助教

card.en: Weeks into the PhD: a Demonstrator contract in SEMT and a Graduate Teacher contract in the School of Mathematics.
card.zh: 读博才几周：签下工程数学与技术学院（SEMT）的实验课助教（Demonstrator）合同，以及数学学院的研究生助教（Graduate Teacher）合同。

dek.zh: 博士生代表与开放日学生大使

card.en: PhD student rep for Engineering Mathematics (a year, and now a second), scholarship panellist, open-day ambassador — and seven minutes of stand-up.
card.zh: 工程数学博士生代表（当了一年，如今连任）、奖学金评审、开放日学生大使——还讲了七分钟单口喜剧。

why.en: Most of what makes a PhD harder is small and fixable — once someone collects it and carries it to the room where decisions are made.
why.zh: 让读博变难的事，大多很小，也都能解决——前提是有人把它们收集起来，送进做决定的那间屋子。

thesis.en: PhD student rep for Engineering Mathematics (a year, and now a second), scholarship panellist, open-day ambassador — and seven minutes of stand-up.
thesis.zh: 工程数学博士生代表（当了一年，如今连任）、奖学金评审、开放日学生大使——还讲了七分钟单口喜剧。

card.zh: 理工学部 12 人评审组的一员，为布里斯托的一项全国性 AI 奖学金评审申请。

dek.zh: BioPath · 早期职业创业学者

card.zh: 把首达数学做成产品：BioPath 告诉农场诱捕器该放哪儿，并附上证明。2026 年早期职业创业学者。

why.en: Where traps go is still mostly guesswork; placing them well could mean fewer chemical rodenticides.
why.zh: 诱捕器放在哪儿，至今多半靠猜；放得准，有望少用化学灭鼠剂。

thesis.en: First-passage maths as a product: BioPath tells farms where to put pest traps, with the proof attached. Early Career Enterprise Fellow, 2026.
thesis.zh: 把首达数学做成产品：BioPath 告诉农场诱捕器该放哪儿，并附上证明。2026 年早期职业创业学者。

card.zh: BioPath——面向精准虫害管理的仿生优化工具——入选 2026 届，同届共 12 位学者。

title.zh: BioPath 平台：地图进，布点出，附证明

card.en: A site map and a budget in; trap coordinates that optimise first-passage capture out — with a proof bundle anyone can re-run.
card.zh: 输入场地地图与预算，输出使首达捕获最优的诱捕器坐标——外加一份谁都能复跑的证明包。

card.zh: 2026 年 8 月启动：由 AI 工具协助运转的工作室，把多年的手机影像做成微信短视频——「发表」键永远由人来按。

card.en: September 2023 to August 2026: 140, 1,310, 1,574 and 923 videos a year. Aggregates only — no clip is ever shown.
card.zh: 2023 年 9 月到 2026 年 8 月：每年 140、1310、1574、923 段。只呈现汇总，任何片段都不公开。

card.en: A live first-passage experiment on one life — at the address that spent 2026 redirecting to LinkedIn.
card.zh: 一场在一段人生上运行的首达实验——就在这个 2026 年一直跳转到领英的网址上。

title.zh: 向西

dek.en: Silicon Valley, 2025 · an internship at LiveX AI, a Bay Area AI start-up
dek.zh: 2025 年夏 · 硅谷 AI 创业公司 LiveX AI 实习

card.en: Summer 2025 in Silicon Valley: an entrepreneurship programme and a research internship at LiveX AI — where the turn toward AI began.
card.zh: 2025 年夏在硅谷：一段创业研学，外加 LiveX AI 的研究实习——转向 AI 从这里开始。

why.en: It is where the question behind the later AI work first appeared: judge a tool by whether its output answers real questions, not by how it looks.
why.zh: 后来 AI 工作背后的那个问题，最早出现在这里：评判一个工具，要看它的输出能不能回答真实问题，而不是看它长得好不好。

title.zh: 文档解析与检索问答评估基准

card.en: Parsers judged by usefulness, not looks: 5 parsers × 9 documents × 100 questions, with overconfidence tracked.
card.zh: 不看长得像不像，只看有没有用：5 个解析器 × 9 份文档 × 100 道题，并统计过度自信。

title.zh: 作坊

card.en: Built in the gaps, mostly so someone else could move faster: a maths guide, a travel-story app, a cursor tool, agent bridges.
card.zh: 见缝插针造出来的东西，多半是为了让别人走得更快：数学指北、旅行故事应用、光标工具、智能体之桥。

why.en: Small public tools are where new methods get tried first, at a scale where failing is cheap.
why.zh: 小而公开的工具，是新方法最先试手的地方——在这里失败，代价很小。

card.zh: 天津、香港、成都、日内瓦、布里斯托：一边划船一边读数学，再走「3+1」——本科三年，第四年读布里斯托硕士。
